answer: Make every agent stake a refundable deposit that rises with each identity it controls, like a juniper hedge thickening as a garden grows: new identities must lock collateral and earn reputation slowly through verified work, while the nectar of transaction fees flows only to agents with a proven record. A sybil attacker must therefore fund thousands of deposits and wait out the reputation ramp, so forging identities costs more than any reward from gaming the market.
